name: Malaka'jin
summary: In Malaka'jin, Darkspear hunters shelter Horde travelers climbing from the Barrens into the lower Stonetalon hills, south of Grimtotem Post.

sections.title: A Hunters' Refuge
sections.body: Beside the main trail into the Stonetalon Mountains, troll hunters keep a small camp among the crags and scrublands. They trade supplies and fresh game with travelers passing through. They also watch for mountain predators and Grimtotem tauren farther up the trails.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Heights
sections.body: Near the Barrens boundary, Malaka'jin gives the Horde an early foothold in Stonetalon. Sun Rock Retreat lies farther north as a larger stronghold. Here, Horde trackers watch for tribal unrest and guard the winding roads against threats.

faq.answer: Malaka'jin is a small Horde village and outpost in the southern Stonetalon Mountains. Darkspear troll hunters live there, offering shelter, trade, and supplies to travelers from the Barrens.
Darkspear troll hunters make their home in Malaka'jin. They hunt mountain game and trade meat and leather with passing adventurers.
Mountain predators threaten Malaka'jin, and hostile Grimtotem tauren live north at Grimtotem Post. The trolls stay alert to aggression from the tribe.

faq.q: Is there a flight master here?
faq.answer: No. Malaka'jin has no flight master. Travelers must use the flight master at Sun Rock Retreat, farther northwest, or follow the road on foot.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can find fellow hunters at Malaka'jin, making a home in the rugged heights far from Kalimdor's tropical shores.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Malaka'jin as a waystation on the trail between the Barrens and the northern mountain strongholds.
